title: Crochet Small Flower Granny Square
author: Loopara
notes: Round 1 already starts with a magic ring; a 'Make a magic ring.' start line was added. A 5-petal flower (sl st, (dc, tr), 3 tr, (tr, dc) petals) squared off in round 5 with graded sc/hdc/dc/tr sides. Round 5's beginning 'chain 5' is read as tr + ch 1 of the first corner (it joins to the 3rd ch of the ch-5). 'dc inc' = 2 dc in one stitch. 'Fasten off, weave in ends' dropped.
